prescription.scope: post-first-return, both-neutral, vacuum Dirac triplet; central semiclassical reduction
prescription.mean_glueball_energy_loss: epsilon*Lambda per full signed radial period
angular_envelopes: maximal downward 1 hbar per effective Lambda emission; not a preferred drift law
prescription.capture: absorbing matching boundary at E<=8 Lambda and L<=1
prescription.capture_threshold_sensitivities: selected E=1,32 Lambda and L=0,10 cards; see source stress artifact
prescription.capture_spin: unspecified by default; no automatic 1/4 population
prescription.unmodeled_spin_sector: annihilation probability retained in [0,1] after capture

missing_physical_inputs: quantum occupation at matching and spin-one annihilation/transition rates
off-gate emission or large-angular/coherent radiation not bounded by this prescription
mixed-charge and pre-first-return evolution not covered by this closure
